name: Canaima National Park
description: Canaima National Park covers about 3 million hectares of south-eastern Venezuela, reaching the borders with Guyana and Brazil. Roughly two-thirds of it is made up of tepuis, flat-topped sandstone mountains that rise from the savanna behind sheer cliffs. Streams pour off their edges as waterfalls, among them the world's tallest, which drops about 1,000 metres.
